name: Weak design: Facebook Groups with age-bucket segments, feature list and vanity metrics
scratchpadNotes: teens, 18-35, 35+. stickers, dark mode, polls, AI posts, badges. DAU MAU

messages.text: How would you improve Facebook Groups to drive deeper member engagement and empower group admins?
Okay so I think the users are teens, people between 18 and 35, and older people above 35. I'll focus on 18 to 35 because they're the biggest group on Facebook.
What problems do they have with Groups today?
They need more fun features. They need stickers in comments, a dark mode for groups, more polls and maybe AI that writes posts for them. They also need badges so they feel rewarded.
Admins can also use the AI to write posts. And they get the badges too. So everyone is happy.
Which of these would you build first, and why?
I'd build all of them, they're all quite easy. Maybe AI posts first because AI is popular right now.
How would you know it worked?
DAU and MAU would go up. And people would spend more time in groups, which is good for Facebook.
